_readme: Episode recaps for the Season One Episode Guide on dancewithdixon.com.
Keyed by the competition's id in the public_site_episodes view (the same
id the Director app uses). Every field is optional; a key with no entry
here simply renders the episode without a recap.
"line": "One sentence. What happened, in Dixon's voice.",
Edit this file by hand after a comp. There is deliberately no admin UI:
one JSON file that survives contact with reality beats a form nobody
opens. JSON has no comments, which is why this note is a key.
